out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: First NDE: "out of my body... floating" but "couldn't turn around." Second NDE: no explicit OBE separation described (awoke into unearthly landscape).
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Also reported: kind of sleeping; sensed hours passing.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Second NDE: identifies the voice/source as a named religious figure by exclamation: "You... You really exist!" and later questionnaire answer indicates yes to encountering a religious figure; narrative implies Jesus but does not explicitly name him.
arrival.other_being_detail: First NDE: shadow-forms of father and mother (alive at the time) and grandmother (deceased). Second NDE: a male figure (source of the Voice) speaking to a seated group.

environment.environment_other_detail: Second NDE: "What a light!" river on left, desert on right, beach across river, "incredible forest." First NDE: "Everything was black... darkness" then luminescence; vision of "four candles around a casket."

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Reason given: "Your son is not born yet; there are many things to do." First NDE: cried to return after feeling family's grief.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: First NDE: "wind blew again" then woke on floor. Second NDE: "I woke up in the recovery room."
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: "Your son is not born yet; there are many things to do. You have to go back."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Two NDEs: (1) hanging at age 13 (1965). (2) shot, emergency surgery under general anesthesia (May 1982).

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Born and raised in a Catholic family; not religious at time.
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Unspecified/uncertain belief in God; "Unaffiliated... secular unaffiliated" and believed afterlife probably does not exist.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: First NDE includes darkness and a funeral/casket scene with candles; second includes river/desert/forest and meeting the source of the Voice.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: First: OBE floating in darkness → voice → luminescence → funeral/casket scene with family → desire to return → waking. Second: awakening into unearthly landscape → voice warnings at river → encounter with a being (source of voice) → told to return → waking in recovery.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeated element: same Voice/being across both NDEs; repeated return instruction/return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: First NDE: vision progresses from faint light to multiple lights and a square shape, then resolves into "four candles around a casket" with shadow-figures; wind seems to move/transport him. Second NDE: repeated inability to turn around; voice warns river is "not water."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Adrian." / "Do you know what you have done?" / "Is this what you want?" / "Don't drink that!" / "Adrian, no, that's not water!" / "Is not your time. Your son is not born yet; there are many things to do. You have to go back."
